42369-motors.title: Motors
42369-motors.creator: J. S. Zerbe, M.E.
42369-motors.description: A book by J. S. Zerbe, M.E.. This work is not intended to set forth the exploits of aviators nor to give a history of the Art. It is a book of instructions intended to point out the theories of flying, as given by the pioneers, the practical application of power to the various flying structures; how they are built; the different methods of controlling them; the advantages and disadvantages of the types now in use; and suggestions as to the directions in which improvements are required.

arxiv-2202-13348.title: Experimental study of turbulent thermal diffusion of particles in inhomogeneous and anisotropic turbulence
arxiv-2202-13348.creator: E. Elmakies, O. Shildkrot, N. Kleeorin, A. Levy, I. Rogachevskii, A. Eidelman
arxiv-2202-13348.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by E. Elmakies, O. Shildkrot, N. Kleeorin, A. Levy, I. Rogachevskii, A. Eidelman. We study experimentally turbulent thermal diffusion of small particles in inhomogeneous and anisotropic stably stratified turbulence produced by one oscillating grid in the air flow. The velocity fields have been measured using a Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV). We have determined various turbulence characteristics: the mean and turbulent velocities, two-point correlation functions of the velocity field and an integral scale of turbulence from the measured velocity fields.

arxiv-2206-12259.title: Exploring shareability networks of probabilistic ride-pooling problems
arxiv-2206-12259.creator: Michał Bujak 1, Rafał Kucharski 1
arxiv-2206-12259.description: Abstract Travellers sharing rides in ride-pooling systems form various kinds of networks. While the notions of the so-called shareability graphs, has been in the core of many ride-pooling algorithms, so far they have not been explicitly analysed. Here, we introduce and examine four kinds of networks resulting from ride-pooling problems.

arxiv-2304-01681.title: Low-PAPR Joint Channel Estimation and Data Detection in ZP-OTFS System
arxiv-2304-01681.creator: Omid Abbassi Aghda, Mohammad Javad Omidi, Hamid Saeedi-Sourck
arxiv-2304-01681.description: Abstract Orthogonal Time Frequency Space (OTFS) systems face significant challenges in channel estimation due to high pilot overhead and peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR). To address these issues, we propose a two-step channel estimation method for Zero-Pad OTFS (ZP-OTFS), a modified OTFS system characterized by multiple zero rows along the delay axis.

arxiv-2304-08538.title: Robust Control Barrier Functions with Uncertainty Estimation
arxiv-2304-08538.creator: Ersin Daş, Skylar X. Wei, Joel W. Burdick
arxiv-2304-08538.description: Abstract This paper proposes a safety controller for control-affine nonlinear systems with unmodelled dynamics and disturbances to improve closed-loop robustness. Uncertainty estimation-based control barrier functions (CBFs) are utilized to ensure robust safety in the presence of model uncertainties, which may depend on control input and states.

arxiv-2310-15041.title: Manipulation Mask Generator: High-Quality Image Manipulation Mask Generation Method Based on Modified Total Variation Noise Reduction
arxiv-2310-15041.creator: 1 st Xinyu Yang, 2 nd Jizhe Zhou
arxiv-2310-15041.description: Abstract In artificial intelligence, any model that wants to achieve a good result is inseparable from a large number of high-quality data. It is especially true in the field of tamper detection. This paper proposes a modified total variation noise reduction method to acquire high-quality tampered images. We automatically crawl original and tampered images from the Baidu PS Bar.

arxiv-2412-14010.title: Astrometry
arxiv-2412-14010.creator: meets
arxiv-2412-14010.description: Abstract High-precision astrometry offers a promising approach to detect low-frequency gravitational waves, complementing pulsar timing array (PTA) observations. We explore the response of astrometric measurements to a stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) in synergy with PTA data. Analytical, covariant expressions for this response are derived, accounting for the presence of a possible dipolar anisotropy in the SGWB.

arxiv-2502-08912.title: Global bifurcations of nodal solutions for coupled elliptic equations
arxiv-2502-08912.creator: Haoyu Li, Olímpio Hiroshi Miyagaki
arxiv-2502-08912.description: Abstract Abstract. We investigate the global bifurcation structure of the radial nodal solutions to the coupled elliptic equations \left\{\begin{array}[]{lr}-{\Delta}u+u=u^{3}+\beta uv^{2}\mbox{ in }B_{1},\\ -{\Delta}v+v=v^{3}+\beta u^{2}v\mbox{ in }B_{1},\\ u,v\in H_{0,r}^{1}(B_{1}).\end{array}\right. Here B_{1} is a unit ball in \mathbb{R}^{3} and \beta\in\mathbb{R} the coupling constant is used as bifurcation parameter.

arxiv-2504-20268.title: Spatio-temporal fusion of reanalysis and in situ data for censored threshold exceedances of PM 2.5 \text{PM}_{2.5}
arxiv-2504-20268.creator: M. Daniela Cuba, Craig Wilkie, Marian Scott, Daniela Castro-Camilo*
arxiv-2504-20268.description: Abstract Abstract Data fusion models are widely used in air quality monitoring to integrate in situ and large-scale gridded products, offering spatially complete and temporally detailed estimates. However, traditional Gaussian-based models often underestimate extreme pollution values, leading to biased risk assessments.

arxiv-2601-17268.title: Learning Accurate Storm-Scale Evolution from Observations
arxiv-2601-17268.creator: Jaideep Pathak, Mohammad Shoaib Abbas, Peter Harrington, Zeyuan Hu, Noah Brenowitz, Suman Ravuri, Alberto Carpentieri, Jussi Leinonen, Corey Adams, Oliver Hennigh, Nicholas Geneva, Dale Durran, Mike Pritchard
arxiv-2601-17268.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jaideep Pathak, Mohammad Shoaib Abbas, Peter Harrington, Zeyuan Hu, Noah Brenowitz, Suman Ravuri, Alberto Carpentieri, Jussi Leinonen, Corey Adams, Oliver Hennigh, Nicholas Geneva, Dale Durran, Mike Pritchard. Accurate short-term prediction of clouds and precipitation is critical for severe weather warnings, aviation safety, and renewable energy operations. Forecasts at this timescale are provided by numerical weather models and extrapolation methods, both of which have limitations.

grant-walk-across-africa-1864.title: A Walk Across Africa; or, Domestic Scenes from my Nile Journal
grant-walk-across-africa-1864.creator: James Augustus Grant
grant-walk-across-africa-1864.description: Grant's A Walk Across Africa (Blackwood, 1864) — his companion narrative to Speke's Nile expedition, the domestic and logistical record of the first traverse from Zanzibar to Egypt.

pmc-11583897.title: Effectiveness of the Sub-Acute Care for Frail Elderly (SAFE) Transitional Care Unit on Short-Term Functional Independence in Frail Older Patients Discharged from Hospital
pmc-11583897.creator: Benoît Robert, Annie H. Sun, Danielle Sinden, Anan B. Eddeen, Maya Murmann, Amy T. Hsu
pmc-11583897.description: BackgroundTransitional care programs help improve continuity of care and post-discharge outcomes for frail older adults who are hospitalized. In this study, we examined the effectiveness of a transitional care model, based in a long-term care (LTC) home, on the functional independence of older hospitalized patients post-discharge.

pmc-12422777.title: Optimizing Surgical Strategies for Elderly Patients With Femoral Neck Fracture: The Critical Role of Comorbidities
pmc-12422777.creator: Ye Peng, Xuezhu Qi, Mingzhi Yu, Gongzi Zhang, Moning Guo, Jianpeng Zheng, Lu Feng, Zaihua Wei, Jianting Su, Danhui Yi, Xinyu Liu, Yao Yao, Lihai Zhang
pmc-12422777.description: Background:Femoral neck fractures (FNFs) pose a notable challenge in the elderly population, given the high associated mortality rates and costs. The choice between internal fixation (IF) and hip arthroplasty (HA) has long been debated, yet existing guidelines often overlooked the crucial influence of comorbidities.

pmc-12543212.title: Hybrid Health IT and Telehealth–Delivered Behavioral Weight Loss Services for Primary Care Patients With Cardiovascular Risk Factors: Intervention Component Design and Pragmatic Randomized Feasibility Trial
pmc-12543212.creator: Ronald T Ackermann, Kenzie A Cameron, David T Liss, Nancy Dolan, Cassandra Aikman, Amy R Carson, Sterling A Harris, Kathryn Doyle, Andrew J Cooper, Brian Hitsman, Michael Dorsch
pmc-12543212.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundIntensive lifestyle interventions (ILI) improve weight loss and cardiovascular risk factors, but health care systems face challenges in implementing them. We engaged stakeholders to cocreate and evaluate primary care implementation strategies for ILI components.ObjectiveThis study aimed to describe the design of intervention components and implementation strategies and to evaluate the feasibility of pragmatic trial enrollment and randomization procedures, as well as the acceptability and preliminary effectiveness of the interventions.MethodsThe study setting was a single, urban primary care office.

pmc-12577538.title: Homozygous Pathogenic MYH3 Variants Associated With Arthrogryposis and Lingual Dystonia
pmc-12577538.creator: Charlotte Mouraux, Claire Fouquet, Keith Durkin, Vinciane Dideberg, Saskia Bulk, David Aktan, Maria Artesi, Frédérique Depierreux
pmc-12577538.description: Introduction:Heterozygous pathogenic variants in MYH3 are known to be responsible for distal arthrogryposis.Case report:We report a consanguineous family of four children with two likely pathogenic MYH3 homozygous variants associated with complex movement disorders, especially prominent lingual dystonia, along with skeletal abnormalities. The two variants in MYH3 (c.3445G>A and c.4760T>C) have already been described in patients with congenital arthrogryposis.

pmc-12692596.title: Comprehensive Liquid Biopsy Approaches for the Clinical Management of Lung Cancer Using Multiple Biological Matrices
pmc-12692596.creator: Areti Strati, Martha Zavridou, Kostas A. Papavassiliou, Athanasios G. Papavassiliou
pmc-12692596.description: Lung cancer is the most commonly diagnosed cancer and the leading cause of cancer-related mortality in both men and women. It is broadly classified into two main histological subtypes, with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) being the most prevalent, accounting for approximately 85–90% of all cases. Liquid biopsy refers to the analysis of tumor-derived material circulating in body fluids.

pmc-12765845.title: Complete neutralizing antibody evasion by serodivergent non-mammalian AAVs enables gene therapy redosing
pmc-12765845.creator: Ezra J. Loeb, Sophia A. Fergione, Vivian Yudistyra, Marco M. Fanous, Abigail R. Benkert, Delaney G. Fisher, Joshua A. Hull, Mai K. ElMallah, Aravind Asokan
pmc-12765845.description: SummaryThe use of adeno-associated virus (AAV) as a gene therapy vector is significantly limited by pre-existing immunity. The high seroprevalence and broad antigenic cross-reactivity of primate-derived AAVs restrict patient eligibility and preclude therapeutic redosing. Here, we harness the phylogenetic diversity of non-mammalian dependoparvoviruses to engineer serologically distinct AAV capsids for immune evasion.

pmc-12836970.title: The importance of early veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation in the management of amniotic fluid embolism complicated by cardiac arrest: a case report and literature review
pmc-12836970.creator: Junyou Su, Jing Luo, Hongfei Chen, Junru Tong, Yan Chen, Lingling Huang, Xiaoting Huang, Shi Liao, Yan Huang, Li Deng
pmc-12836970.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAmniotic fluid embolism (AFE) with cardiac arrest is an obstetric emergency with an exceedingly high maternal mortality. Early application of veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VA-ECMO) may provide essential cardiopulmonary support, but its clinical value warrants further investigation.Case reportThis report describes the successful management of a 36-year-old parturient with advanced maternal age who sustained sudden cardiac arrest due to AFE during the second stage of labor.

pmc-12996984.title: XRE-type transcriptional regulator ProR controls prodigiosin synthesis in Serratia marcescens JNB5-1
pmc-12996984.creator: Mi Tang, Yanan Hao, Yixuan Zhao, Yanan Li, Jiajia You, Taowei Yang, Xuewei Pan, Zhiming Rao
pmc-12996984.description: The gram-negative bacterium Serratia marcescens produces various secondary metabolites, including prodigiosin, althiomycin, and serratamolide. Among these, prodigiosin exhibits multiple biological activities such as antibacterial, anticancer, and immunosuppressive properties. Nevertheless, our understanding of the regulatory mechanisms governing prodigiosin biosynthesis in S. marcescens remains incomplete.

pmc-13318567.title: Traditional Chinese medicine syndrome patterns and associated factors in adults with type 2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome: a data-driven analysis
pmc-13318567.creator: Jialing Zhang, Zhilin Lin, Shuyan Zhong, Minxia Ma, Hoi Ki Wong, Liz Sin Li, Kenneth Ka Hei Lo, Zhaoxiang Bian

pmc-13379171.title: Multimodality Imaging Evaluation of Hepatic Epithelioid Angiomyolipoma
pmc-13379171.creator: Yi-Tzu Chen, Ying-Ju Kuo, Suk Yee Lau, Chui-Mei Tiu, Yi-Hong Chou
pmc-13379171.description: Hepatic epithelioid angiomyolipoma (HEAML) is a rare benign tumor in the liver. It is crucial to differentiate HEAML from hepatocellular carcinoma. We herein report the case of a 42-year-old female who was diagnosed with HEAML by multiple imaging studies. The histopathological examination also confirmed the diagnosis. Imaging studies include magnetic resonance imaging, digital subtraction angiography (DSA), and contrast-enhanced ultrasound (US).

pmc-13409911.title: MEK1 as a Synthetic Lethal Target with Cabozantinib in Renal Cell Carcinoma: Insights from CRISPR/Cas9 Screening
pmc-13409911.creator: Hirofumi Yoshino, Ikumi Fukuda, Hideki Enokida, Naohiko Seki, Yusuke Goto
pmc-13409911.description: Background/Objectives: Cabozantinib is a tyrosine kinase inhibitor that primarily targets MET. It has become an important drug in the treatment of renal cell carcinoma (RCC); however, many patients do not respond to cabozantinib treatment and there is no effective next-line therapy. In this study, we identified molecular-targeted drugs that exhibit synergistic effects with cabozantinib using CRISPR/Cas9 screening.

pmc-13588124.title: Pili Annulati in a Black-Haired Asian Woman
pmc-13588124.creator: Daxing Wu, Jianzhong Xu, Danni Hua, Lifeng Wu
pmc-13588124.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pili annulati (PA) is a rare autosomal dominant hair shaft disorder characterized by alternating light and dark bands along the hair shaft. It is more commonly observed in individuals with blond or light-colored hair, while cases in patients with dark hair are uncommon, as the greater amount of hair pigment can obscure the banding pattern, making it more difficult to recognize.

pmc-13616777.title: Nationwide epinephrine auto-injector dispensing in Greece: a drug-utilization study providing insights into anaphylaxis epidemiology and emergency-treatment preparedness
pmc-13616777.creator: George N. Konstantinou
pmc-13616777.description: BackgroundAnaphylaxis is a serious systemic hypersensitivity reaction requiring prompt recognition and treatment, yet diagnosis-linked national surveillance is unavailable in many countries. Epinephrine auto-injector (EAI) dispensing cannot identify confirmed events or individual patients, but it is an epidemiologically relevant medication-use endpoint because EAIs are supplied to people with prior anaphylaxis or a clinically judged risk of future anaphylaxis.

pmc-13635042.title: Chromovitrectomy: current evidence, emerging technologies, and practical applications in vitreoretinal surgery
pmc-13635042.creator: Federico Giannuzzi, Lorenzo Hu, Mattia Cusato, Matteo Mario Carlà, Emanuele Crincoli, Federico Maragno, Valentina Cestrone, Umberto De Vico, Stanislao Rizzo
pmc-13635042.description: Chromovitrectomy has revolutionized vitreoretinal surgery by enabling the visualization of nearly transparent intraocular structures. This review evaluates the clinical utility of key vital dyes, such as brilliant blue G, trypan blue, indocyanine green, and triamcinolone acetonide, focusing on their physicochemical properties, staining affinities, and safety profiles.

pmc-13652724.title: Is the adult EBMT risk score valid and relevant for hematopoietic stem cell transplantation in children acute leukemia?
pmc-13652724.creator: F. Baleydier, J. E. Galimard, F. Bernard, F. Gonzales, A. Dalissier, A. Al-Seraihy, J.-H. Dalle, C. R. S. Uppugunduri, L. Zubarovskaya, M. Zecca, F. Locatelli, A. Kulagin, F. Fagioli, S. Robinson, A. Balduzzi, A. Biffi, Y. Chalandon, P. Bader, S. Corbacioglu, Krzysztof Kalwak, M. Ansari
pmc-13652724.description: The EBMT risk score, incorporating five factors to estimate the risks associated with haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) in adult patients, has not been validated in children. This study aims to assess this score in 9447 children undergoing allogeneic HSCT for acute lymphoblastic or myeloid leukemia (ALL/AML) between 2010 and 2021.

pmc-13678489.title: Advances and applications of engineered protein therapeutics and their role in precision medicine
pmc-13678489.creator: Wadha Aldossary, Nada Alqahtani, Layla Asiri, Noora Alkhurayef, Samar Alagl, Sana Alturki, Duha Saad, Mashael Al Yahya, Samah Al-Harthi
pmc-13678489.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Proteins are a vital class of biomolecules. They play essential roles in biological processes, including building cellular structures, forming cellular channels and receptors, catalyzing biological reactions, transporting molecules, and contributing to immune defense mechanisms. Advances in protein engineering have enabled the genetic modification of naturally occurring proteins, using recombinant deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) technology, leading to the development of therapeutic proteins with enhanced specificity, stability, and clinical performance.
